PATTERN: Docker Compose with 3 services
COMPONENTS:
- postgres:17-alpine: main DB, volume persisted
- playwright service: Express HTTP server at port 3002, based on mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image, POST /upload accepts image → returns Vinted UUID
- app: Next.js standalone build, port 3003, depends on both postgres and playwright
WHY: Playwright must run as separate process — running inside Next.js API route context causes processes to hang indefinitely
KEY: `shm_size: 1gb` for Playwright + `tmpfs: /tmp: size=2g` to prevent 'No space left on device' errors from Chromium profiles
HOW TO MIGRATE: `docker compose exec app npx prisma migrate deploy`
ENV VARS NEEDED: DATABASE_URL, GEMINI_API_KEY, AUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL=http://playwright:3002, ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=true, NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=true (build arg)
